authorized_scope: Use the universal Transputer and terminal for authenticated, unambiguous, losslessly replayable communication among admitted repository nodes.
identified_gaps: Existing authenticated TCP adapter lacks encryption.
Standalone terminal and bus peer could not share the same store concurrently.
Peer names were not bound to a per-repository exact-subject directory.
implemented: TLS 1.3 mutual authentication, CA/hostname verification, explicit certificate fingerprints and certificate-to-bus-identity binding.
Stable per-repository identity and distinct exact subject; stale or wrong receiver subject rejected.
Shared single store owner for local terminal, durable bus outbox, receive projection and exact correlated receipts.
Supervisor lifetime binding, service group cleanup and restart without resetting history.
execution_scope: Executor resolves the actual committed HEAD/TREE. Three-process all-directed-pairs gate; optional independently resolved repository-context execution.
acceptance: All directed pairs carry actual bytes and receivers return durable exact-correlated receipts.
Wrong subject, certificate, hostname and router pin fail closed.
SIGKILL, partition, replay and terminal re-entry preserve acknowledged bytes and old event files.
Full existing C90, Rust, sanitizer, exchange, continuity, hardware and distribution gates remain mandatory.
limits: Trusted single router; no encryption against its operator.
Finite 16-peer and message-size bounds; admission fails on overflow.
Delivery is at least once; arbitrary external effects are not globally exactly once.
Source persistence and tests do not establish deployment of public endpoints or universal reachability.
Production private credentials remain outside Git and images.
